mines.mine_notes: Processing facility in Potosi sourcing oxide ore from third parties. 2025: 4.5 Moz silver delivered, 53,854 AuEq oz produced; cash gross operating margin US$16.11 per silver oz, gross margin ratio 42.75%. P&P reserves 11.95 Moz recoverable Ag @ 93 g/t (Feb 2024 technical report; 4.6-yr life of operation). June 2, 2025: exclusive long-term agreement with state-owned COMIBOL to purchase up to 7 Mt of oxide ore (first ore expected H2 2026). Gold ounces not separately disclosed.

Soledad Mountain mine, western Mojave Desert, Kern County, California (acquired Nov 2023). Open-pit gold-silver. 2025: 45,311 AuEq oz (41,627 oz gold + 331,576 oz silver); cash costs US$1,698/oz Au, AISC US$2,194/oz Au. Jan 2024 Soledad Mountain Technical Report: LOM avg annual production up to 65,000 oz gold + 466,000 oz silver for 5 years. 2025 exploration program (Hilltop drilling) to extend mine life.

notes: FY2025 record year across all key metrics: revenue US$359.8M (Q4: US$133.7M); Q4 operating cash flow US$51.0M, FCF US$35.8M; ended 2025 with ~US$121.8M net cash (US$166.8M liquid assets incl. US$79.2M cash + US$60.7M marketable securities; US$45.1M debt). Consolidated 2025 production slightly below 100,000 AuEq oz (Q4: 27,777 AuEq oz); San Bartolome 53,854 AuEq oz + Golden Queen 45,311 AuEq oz = 99,165 AuEq oz. Graduated from TSX-V to TSX Jan 9, 2025. Executive Chairman & CEO Alberto Morales. All amounts in USD. Additional listing: OTCQX:ANPMF.
